_comment: How much a wrong quantity matters to the finished dish. With a meal kit this question never arises — the box holds one pre-portioned sachet and the cook tips it in. Buying from a supermarket, every such line becomes a measurement the cook performs against an estimated quantity, and the estimate is only as good as ingredient_spice_doses.json. Severity scales with potency per gram: too much ground cloves ruins a dish, too much oregano does not. 'high' earns a visible estimate warning in the UI; 'forgiving' is recorded so the warning is not shown where it would be noise. Anything unlisted is 'normal'. Resolution: exact by_name -> first substring in by_keyword -> normal. See app/measures.py.
